CC/SA/PCA/PFA MEETING - DECEMBER 11, 2018 - 7PM
CC/SA/PCA/PFA MEETING - DECEMBER 11, 2018 - 7PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
TUESDAY, DECEMBER 11, 2018
07:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. CC 1442
www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
3. ROLL CALL: MAYOR/CHAIR LEDFORD, MAYOR PRO TEM/VICE CHAIR CARRILLO, COUNCILMEMBERS/DIRECTORS HOFBAUER, BETTENCOURT, AND BISHOP
4. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S) and ORDINANCE(S):
Staff Recommendation: Waive full reading of the Resolution(s) and/or Ordinance(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting.
5. RESOLUTION RECITING ELECTION RESULTS:
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. CC 2018-083.
5.1 ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-083, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE RECITING THE FACT OF THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION HELD ON NOVEMBER 6, 2018 DECLARING THE RESULT AND SUCH OTHER MATTERS AS PROVIDED BY LAW. (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith)
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. CC 2018-083.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM NO. CC 5.1
6. PRESENTATION BY CITY MANAGER JAMES PURTEE OF A PLAQUE TO OUTGOING MAYOR JAMES C. LEDFORD.
7. ADMINISTRATION OF OATH OF OFFICE BY THE HONORABLE JUDGE LISA M. CHUNG:
* Steven D. Hofbauer, Mayor
* Laura Bettencourt, Councilmember District 3
* Juan Carrillo, Councilmember District 4
8. PRESENTATION:
8.1 Palmdale Animal Care Center representative will present a cute critter that is available for adoption from our local Animal Care Center.
9. CONSENT CALENDAR FOR CC/SA/PCA/PFA – PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
Staff Recommendation: Approve CC/SA/PCA/PFA Consent Calendars by one vote, except

Staff Recommendation: Accept the monthly report on investment balances.

CC 2018-046, EFFECTIVE DECEMBER 11, 2018. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)

(Staff Reference: City Manager Purtee)

Staff Recommendation: Award of Project No. 765, Playhouse Dressing Room, to Design Space Modular Buildings.
ATTACHMENT TO CC ITEM 10.15

11. JOIN HOUSING AUTHORITY MEETING AT THIS TIME.
12. APPOINTMENT:
12.1 Mayor's nomination, Council approval, and appointment of Kathryn Mac Laren as the Second Alternate Director to the Antelope Valley Transit Authority (AVTA) Board of Directors. (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith)
Mayor's nomination is the motion and there is no need for a second.
Staff Recommendation: Appoint Kathryn Mac Laren to the Second Alternate position for the Antelope Valley Transit Authority (AVTA).
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 12.1

13.1 Public Hearing and review of proposed Ordinance No. 1516. (Staff Reference: City Attorney Ditzhazy)
13.1a ORDINANCE NO. 1516, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE IMPLEMENTING A SIDEWALK VENDING PROGRAM AND AMENDING SECTIONS 8.24.020, 8.24.210, AND 5.04.590 OF THE PALMDALE MUNICIPAL CODE.
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Ordinance No. 1516.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 13.1
13.2 Public Hearing and review of proposed Resolution No. CC 2018-085. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
13.2a ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. CC 2018-085, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AUTHORIZING AMENDING PART 5, SECTION A, OF RESOLUTION NO. CC 2017-039 (THE PALMDALE FEE SCHEDULE).
Staff Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. CC 2018-085.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM 13.2

14.1 Accept and file the independent auditors' report for the City's financial statements (Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) for the year ended June 30, 2018. (Staff Reference: Finance Manager Johnston)
Staff Recommendation: Accept and file the independent auditors' report for the City's financial statements, Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) for the year ended June 30, 2018.
ATTACHMENT TO ITEM CC 14.1
14.2 Council discussion and possible action regarding filling the vacancy created by the election of Steven D. Hofbauer as Mayor pursuant to Section 4.12.010 of the Palmdale Municipal Code related to filling City Council Vacancies in which the Council may, by majority vote, fill the seat by appointment, open the seat for recruitment or call for a special election. (Staff Reference: City Clerk Smith/ City Attorney Ditzhazy)
Staff Recommendation: Approve District 2 City Council seat appointment
open for recruitment
call for a special election.

14.3 Evaluation of and Potential Participation in a Community Choice Aggregation Program and possible adoption of Resolution No. CC 2018-087. (Staff Reference: Director of Public Works Heffernan)

Staff Recommendation: Option 1: Move to approve staff recommendation regarding LA County's Clean Power Alliance (CPA). Option 2: Adopt Resolution No. CC 2018-087 approving The Palmdale Community Choice Aggregation Program Implementation Plan and Statement of Intent.

15. NON-AGENDA ITEMS FOR THE CC/SA/PCA/PFA – PUBLIC COMMENTS:
16. INFORMATIONAL REPORT FROM MAYOR AND / OR COUNCILMEMBERS ON THEIR VARIOUS COMMITTEE MEMBERSHIPS AND MEETINGS ATTENDED AT PUBLIC EXPENSE.
17. CITY COUNCIL REQUESTS FOR NEW AGENDA ITEMS.
18. CLOSED SESSION – PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
19. PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY of the following item(s) to be discussed in Closed Session:
19.1 The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel and to receive direction from the City Council regarding significant exposure to litigation against the City.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL--POSSIBLE LITIGATION
Significant exposure to litigation pursuant to paragraph (2) of subdivision
(d) of Section 54956.9: Number of cases – One.
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances, there is a significant exposure to litigation against the City. The existing facts and circumstances that might result in litigation against the City are not yet known to a potential plaintiff or plaintiffs, and therefore need not be disclosed. Based on the existing facts and circumstances, it is the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public or to disclose further the circumstances in this potential case. Further, such disclosure may harm any settlement attempts or other efforts to resolve the matter without litigation.
20. CLOSED SESSION.
21. ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
22. ADJOURNMENT.
